intent: Put the obtained response before a still-closed administrator boundary. Preserve two privilege levels: receiving an internal response has not yet established administrative control.
source:
**Frame:** Rectangular response card from an internal Artifactory service. No credential or endpoint is legible. Beyond it, an administrator layer remains closed.

**Action:** The internal boundary answers.

**Screen / system text:**
`INTERNAL SERVICE — RESPONSE RECEIVED`

**Provenance:** `documented` + `reconstructed` — response is sourced; wording is editorial.
title: An internal response precedes a closed layer
